title: Per-Tenant Rate Limit, Budget and Cache Gateway
instructions: Implement `create_app` in `tenant_gate.py` (`Generation` and the constants are provided): a FastAPI `POST /chat` that applies, in order, a per-tenant token-bucket rate limit, an exact-match TTL cache (temperature 0 only), a per-tenant daily budget guard and the injected `generate` call. Time comes only from the injected `clock`, rate limits and budget exhaustion use different 429 bodies, and provider failures return 502 without spend or caching.

evidence.label: A burst is allowed, then 429 rate_limited with a ceil-based Retry-After header
The token bucket refills according to the injected clock
Rate limits are tracked per tenant
A cache hit costs nothing, skips the provider and is still rate limited
The cache is tenant-scoped and ignores non-zero temperatures
Budget exhaustion is a distinct 429 without Retry-After and resets the next UTC day
The daily budget is tracked per tenant
A provider failure returns 502 upstream_failed and costs nothing
A missing tenant header or an invalid body returns 422
